title: tiledb_healthcheck
description: Checks if a provided location can be queried as a TileDB-SOMA database.

input database.title: Input database
input database.description: Open a TileDB SOMA database by URI.

input_uri.description: If specified, a URI containing the TileDB-SOMA objects.

s3_region.description: Region where the TileDB-SOMA database is hosted.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
